people.name: Galatia
people.line: A region in Asia Minor, recipient of Paul's epistle.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
translations.bsb: O foolish Galatians! Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.
translations.kjv: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
translations.asv: O foolish Galatians, who did bewitch you, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth crucified?
